videos.title: Building a 200€ Product for 30€: ESP32 Autonomous Plant Waterer Teardown & Build
ESP32 Submersible Pump, Reservoir & Capacitive Soil Sensor Assembly

note: Analyzed 4 key disassembly timestamps via Gemini 4 Argon multimodal video inspection.

frames.description: Lower housing separated to expose the 750mL cylindrical water reservoir, bottom acoustic isolation cradle, and 5V brushless centrifugal micro-pump.

parts.name: 750mL Watertight Reservoir Tank
parts.function: Stores 750mL of irrigation water with 3.5mm watertight PETG perimeter walls and top bayonet locking ring.

parts.name: 5V Brushless Submersible Micro-Pump
parts.function: Delivers 120 L/h water flow from reservoir floor through vertical 6mm outlet barb.
parts.material: ABS impeller housing + epoxy-potted brushless stator
parts.fasteners: Snap-fits into PRT-03 compliant isolation cradle + 6mm silicone barb

frames.description: Top deck removal revealing the twist-lock refill funnel lid, silicone riser grommet, and rim-mounted dual barbed Y-manifold seated above the high-water line.

parts.name: Twist-Lock Reservoir Funnel Lid
parts.function: Seals reservoir top while providing a recessed refill funnel and controller mounting rails.
parts.fasteners: Bayonet twist-lock tabs + 8mm silicone pass-through grommet

parts.name: Anti-Siphon Dual Barbed Drip Manifold
parts.function: Splits pump output to 2 pots at Z=98mm above waterline to break gravity siphons.

frames.description: Close-up of the top electronics bench showing 4 self-tapping 2.15mm M2.5 standoffs, Seeed XIAO ESP32-C3 MCU, and low-side MOSFET pump switch.

parts.name: ESP32 Controller & MOSFET Housing
parts.function: Protects microcontroller and MOSFET driver above the lid splash zone.
parts.fasteners: 4x M2.5x6mm stainless socket head cap screws + 0.25mm snap bezel
parts.offTheShelfQuery: M2.5x6mm stainless socket head cap screws

parts.name: Seeed XIAO ESP32-C3 & MOSFET Driver
parts.function: Reads capacitive moisture analog voltage and pulses 5V pump via PWM MOSFET switch.
parts.offTheShelfQuery: Seeed Studio XIAO ESP32C3 MOSFET switch module

frames.description: Root-zone delivery assembly pairing two 3D-printed conical labyrinth emitter spikes with a corrosion-free capacitive soil moisture sensor probe.

parts.name: Root-Zone Labyrinth Drip Emitter Spike (×2)
parts.function: Guides water directly to plant roots with cross-ribbed conical shaft and top 6mm barb.
parts.fasteners: 6mm barbed top inlet for 6mm ID silicone tubing
parts.offTheShelfQuery: drip irrigation emitter stakes 1/4 inch barb

parts.name: Capacitive Soil Moisture Sensor Probe v1.2
parts.function: Measures soil dielectric permittivity (1.2V wet to 2.8V dry) without exposed metal electrodes.
parts.fasteners: JST-PH 2.0mm 3-pin cable to controller ADC input
parts.offTheShelfQuery: capacitive soil moisture sensor v1.2 corrosion resistant
